strings.zh: 听说关东地区最近出现了{NEWLINE}一个名为火箭队的邪恶组织。{SCROLL}但愿这个火箭队不要来我们枯叶市吧。
strings.en: I hear an evil group called Team Rocket{NEWLINE}has shown up in Kanto lately.{SCROLL}I hope this Team Rocket doesn’t come to{NEWLINE}our Vermilion City.

strings.zh: 好想去金黄市的商店买东西啊。{SCROLL}毕竟那里可是坐落着{NEWLINE}最大的精灵道具生产商{CLEAR}西鲁夫公司的总部呢。
strings.en: I’d love to go shopping in Saffron City.{SCROLL}After all, that’s where Silph Co.,{NEWLINE}the biggest maker of Pokémon{CLEAR}items, has its headquarters.

strings.zh: 多亏联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}大人的活跃,{NEWLINE}邪恶组织火箭队已经被彻底消灭了。
strings.en: Thanks to League Champion {VAR:0103:0}, the{NEWLINE}evil Team Rocket is gone for good.
